description: This PHP class implements the ScopeRepositoryInterface from the League OAuth2 Server package, providing methods for retrieving scope entities and finalizing scopes in OAuth2 authentication flow.

classes.name: ScopeRepository
classes.description: Implements scope management functions for OAuth2 authorization, including retrieving scope entities by identifier and finalizing scopes based on grant type and client.

methods.name: getScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a scope entity based on the provided identifier.

methods.name: finalizeScopes
methods.description: Returns the provided scopes as-is, potentially for further processing or validation.
